qualification: Aspect rows are bounded reviewer coverage, not independently executed scenarios. Every executable check is source-only.

rows.qualification: Shared manifest defines10s and eight selected typed delimiters; old adapter no-delay header is stale.
Windows/Linux caps_word corresponds to macOS capsword; different ids are an explicit catalogue alias.
State owner flips the Boolean and arms/disarms then synchronizes native CapsLock. Actual state/LED not executed.
Native intent is seeded pre-pump and ORed with CapsWord for LED; ending temporary mode preserves genuine CapsLock.
ToggleCapsLock deactivates then flips recorded intent without deriving it from its own LED output.

Callable dispatcher would deactivate before remapped Backspace, but actual SC039 admission competes with native CapsWord hotkey. Existing include-order test does not prove HotIf priority; physical repro not confirmed.
Tap-only SC00F route declines empty AI tooltip then deactivates for physical tab before emitting Backspace; no CapsWord SC00F competitor.
Non-delimiter physical id misses its real emitted Enter; hidden native key output has no CapsWord observer.
An admitted AltGr tap unconditionally clears before caps_word toggles; repeated tap cannot turn off.
AltGr Backspace pre-clears with all automatic-end settings disabled; do not count another root.
Suspend and recent activity cancellation occur before shared dispatcher deactivation; real key/timer dispatch unexecuted.
Dedicated hotkeys ask active selected delimiter and pass generation through send/wait finally; sender false/native timing not measured.
Typed character callback evaluates full payload via shared policy; actual Tab/IME capture not executed.
Recorded literal text from layout ring and TextSend/hotstrings calls shared observer; actual dead-key/IME/native payload qualification remains.
Native-key funnel uses SendLevel0 and synthetic buffer model without CapsWord literal publication; covered as CW-W001 opposite-direction mechanism.
TextSend direct reports only after successful sender verdict; native receiving not measured.
Native/clipboard TextSend reports at queueing, potentially before later admission refusal. No common pending-output policy established; not a confirmed third defect.
Five Windows manifest kinds map left/right/middle/X buttons and native movement; actual devices unexecuted.
All four scroll directions count as pointer_motion; disabling that kind keeps CapsWord through these mappings.
Windows gesture kind absent by manifest reason; OS-owned gesture signals distinct from observable scrolling.
Poll returns on unchanged coordinates and current activation records a fresh position. No throttle carried from old session.
Zero arms no idle timer or key-down reset subscription; runtime timer behavior not measured.
Every dispatcher key-down rearms armed idle; no modifier-key filter. Linux may differ and broad shared keystroke semantics need comparison.
Configured delay schedules timer; no manual32-bit tick subtraction in this module, so no rollover defect asserted.
Successful store publishes Configured/Values for next activation; active Armed policy and current timers are intentionally retained. CrossOS product intent not inferred.
ConfigCommitUpdates must return success before publishing policy. No disk write/persistence replay executed.
Bound original generation must equal current before borrowing active state. Existing AHK timer interruption tests reviewed not executed.
Generation advances and owner fields detach before unregister, timer cancellation or logger boundary.
Saved end callback retired before logging then exact retired generation rechecked under Critical; successor cannot be ended by old logger continuation.
Native delimiter keeps original generation through send and bounded wait/finally; old operation cannot retire replacement activation.
Precise key-down versus already-entered idle callback needs real AHK scheduler fixture; no promoted race without admitted reproducible interruption.
Central dispatcher rejects events while suspended and lifecycle explicitly deactivates CapsWord before pause. Actual pause/native lock unexecuted.
Fatal net clears flag and synchronizes LED; inactive future callbacks disarm; native lock/refusal not executed.
Shutdown has no explicit CapsWord restore, successor seeds current native toggle; native AHK exit restoration unresolved, kept conditional rather than confirmed.
Source-scanned markers cannot establish actual configured tap semantics; direct state tests bypass AltGr producer. Existing tests not claimed executed.
No G4, wall-clock latency or long-duration memory-growth measurements. Source cleanup topology reviewed only.
No real editor/caps LED/keypad Enter/IME/deadkey/pointer or live Win32 hook was exercised.
